name: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma

criteria.description: Presence of atypical 'flower cells' or multilobulated lymphocytes in peripheral blood
Detection of clonal T-cell receptor gene rearrangement
Generalized lymphadenopathy with histopathological confirmation of T-cell lymphoma

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: HTLV-1 seropositivity plus presence of atypical lymphocytes and clonal T-cell receptor gene rearrangement
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other T-cell malignancies and correlation with clinical features.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Atypical multilobulated 'flower cells' in peripheral blood

searchTerms: swollen lymph nodes all over body
general lymph node swelling confirmed by biopsy
frequent urination and confusion from calcium

common.symptomName: Skin lesions including erythematous papules and plaques
searchTerms: red papules and plaques on skin
losing weight and sweating at night

occasional.symptomName: Bone pain due to osteolytic lesions

searchTerms: repeated infections due to immune problems

rare.symptomName: Central nervous system involvement with meningeal infiltration
searchTerms: central nervous system involvement with meninges
heart tissue infiltration causing irregular heartbeat
abnormal heart rhythms due to infiltration

rare.symptomName: Renal impairment secondary to tumor infiltration

laboratory: Peripheral blood smear showing atypical multilobulated lymphocytes ('flower cells')
imaging: CT scan showing generalized lymphadenopathy and hepatosplenomegaly
Bone scintigraphy or MRI revealing osteolytic lesions
genetic: HTLV-1 proviral DNA integration in malignant cells
other: Histopathological confirmation of peripheral T-cell lymphoma in lymph node biopsy
Immunophenotyping showing CD4+ CD25+ T-cell population

distinguishingFeatures: Lack of characteristic 'flower cells' in peripheral blood
Presence of Sezary cells rather than 'flower cells'

redFlags: Rapidly progressive lymphadenopathy with systemic symptoms
Presence of atypical multilobulated lymphocytes in peripheral blood smear
references: Shimoyama M. Diagnostic criteria and classification of clinical subtypes of adult T-cell leukemia-lymphoma. Leukemia Research. 1991.
Ratner L, et al. Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma: clinical and molecular features. Hematology Am Soc Hematol Educ Program. 2016.
Uchiyama T, et al. Adult T-cell leukemia: clinical and hematologic features of 16 cases. Blood. 1977.
